how_called: the public API: POST https://api.inola.tech/v1/infer, model decider-mini; the version is the one the API answered with on every question. The API returns calibrated probabilities, no logits. A question of kind tfu is asked as a choice of three (true / false / unknown) and is not scored
command: python -m decision_sets run --api https://api.inola.tech --model decider-mini --out <dir> --sets boolq --threads 8
hardware: the service's host: one NVIDIA RTX A4000
sampling: none: one call per question; sets of more than 3000 questions are drawn with seed 0 (BoolQ). Questions that got HTTP 503 (overloaded) were asked again
excluded_ids: questions whose state text occurs in the training data of this version (tools/overlap.py); left out of metrics.json
